sentences.text: Pedro Heilbron, born in 1958, has led Copa Holdings as chief executive since 1988 and in July 2025 also took on the role of executive chairman, combining both positions.

sentences.quote: he holds a B.A. in economics from College of the Holy Cross and an MBA from George Washington University.
sentences.text: He holds a B.A. in economics from the College of the Holy Cross and an MBA from George Washington University.

Under his leadership Copa grew from a regional carrier with two aircraft and $20 million in revenue into one of the three large Latin American airline groups, joined Star Alliance in 2012, and he has chaired the Star Alliance CEO board since 2016; the "Hub of the Americas" strategy is his creation, and his thirty-eight years in the seat make him arguably the longest-tenured major airline CEO in the world.

sentences.quote: His brother Alvaro Heilbron sits on the board, and the board is thick with Motta family interests (the controlling shareholders).
sentences.text: His brother Alvaro Heilbron sits on a board heavily weighted toward the controlling Motta family interests.

sentences.text: Pedro Heilbron continues as Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, a combined role he assumed on July 1, 2025 after Stanley Motta stepped down as non-executive Chairman and remained a board member; Peter Donkersloot Ponce remains Chief Financial Officer and Robert Carey Executive Vice President, with no further senior changes disclosed in the past year.
Management announced an order for 40 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft plus 20 options and a shift of the Panama hub from six to eight connecting banks from March 2027.

sentences.quote: "Our second quarter results demonstrate the resilience of our business model in a significantly higher fuel price environment," Executive Chairman and CEO Pedro Heilbron said.
